statement: Let the sequence of real numbers $(a_n)$, $n=1,2,3,\ldots$ with $a_1=2$ and $a_n=\left(\dfrac{n+1}{n-1}\right)(a_1+a_2+\cdots+a_{n-1})$, $n\geq 2$. Find the term $a_{2013}$.

We define the sets $A_1,A_2,\ldots,A_{160}$ such that $|A_i|=i$ for all $i=1,2,\ldots,160$. With the elements of these sets we create new sets $M_1,M_2,\ldots,M_n$ by the following procedure: in the first step we choose some of the sets $A_1,\ldots,A_{160}$ and remove from each of them the same number of elements; the removed elements form $M_1$. In the second step we repeat the procedure on the remaining sets to define $M_2$, and so on until there are no more elements. Find the minimum value of $n$.

Let a triangle $ABC$ inscribed in circle $c(O,R)$ and $D$ an arbitrary point on $BC$ (different from the midpoint). The circumscribed circle of $BOD$ (which is $c_1$) meets $c(O,R)$ at $K$ and $AB$ at $Z$. The circumscribed circle of $COD$ ($c_2$) meets $c(O,R)$ at $M$ and $AC$ at $E$. Finally the circumscribed circle of $AEZ$ ($c_3$) meets $c(O,R)$ at $N$. Prove that $\triangle ABC\cong\triangle KMN$.
